title: VMware vCenter CVE-2026-123890 (CVSS 9.8): Directory Service authentication bypass gives an administrator session without credentials
content_md:
VMware vCenter, CVE-2026-123890 (CVSS 9.8): authentication bypass in the Directory Service, administrator session without credentials. The source text cuts off after this point.
